page.text:
The ladder from magma to semigroup to monoid represents a sequence of algebraic
refinements that enrich the equational theory while preserving the underlying carrier
and operation. Categorically, this hierarchy is governed by faithful forgetful functors:
$$ \mathbf{Mon} \longrightarrow \mathbf{SemiGrp} \longrightarrow \mathbf{Magma} \longrightarrow \mathbf{Set}. $$
Any equational theorem established for a less restrictive structure (such as
generalized associativity in semigroups) holds universally across all subsequent
specializations (including monoids, groups, rings, and fields) without separate
proof.
